app.name: MedRemind
app.tagline: Accessible & Reliable Health and Medicine Assistant for Elderly and Family
app.disclaimer: This is a medication reminder and adherence tool, not a doctor or emergency dispatch system.

dashboard.missSuccess: Marked as missed. Please do not take double doses without consulting your doctor.

caregivers.revokeConfirm: Are you sure you want to revoke this caregiver access immediately?

prescriptions.subtitle: Snap a photo or upload prescription document
prescriptions.uploadPrompt: Take photo or upload file (JPG, PNG, PDF)

emergency.title: Emergency Assistance (SOS)
emergency.subtitle: Fast one-tap contact during distress
emergency.sosConfirmTitle: Do you want to call your emergency contact?
emergency.sosConfirmDesc: This will launch your phone dialer. You must tap Call on your phone.
emergency.disclaimer: Warning: This does not replace emergency ambulance services (112 / 108). In severe crisis call 112 immediately.
emergency.consent: I consent to contacting this individual during health emergencies.

settings.title: App Settings & Privacy

voice.emergencyHelpReply: Dial 112 for emergency help or call your primary emergency contact.
voice.todayScheduleReply: Your next scheduled medicine today is {name}.
voice.allDoneReply: All scheduled medicines for today are completed.
